title: The eleven
notes: The surface team who stayed for the fieldwork (LORE.md 1b). The ship calls them the

lines.text: Eleven of my people were on the surface in February.
Shepard's survey team. When the ship went dark they stayed.
I could have ordered them up. I let them finish the work.
Shepard came up in July. The other ten are still down there.

options.text: Why did you let them stay?

lines.text: Because the work was good and I thought we had time.
And because they asked. People don't often ask, in this chair.
Each of them carries a beacon. When one goes off, we hear it.
So does your shuttle, if her core is loaded and she's listening.
Get to them, and we'll do the rest from up here.
Some of them, yes. Up the transporter, one at a time.
Somebody down there has been finding them and calling us.
She looks at you a moment longer than she needs to.
Whoever that is has my thanks. Whether they want it or not.
Their names are on a padd by my chair. I cross nobody off.
Shepard gave you the list. You'll know it as well as I do.
If you hear a beacon, it's one of them. Nobody else has one.
